items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: my dear friend Jimmy Rushing, your piano player, Lee Wesley Jones

ctx.x: (Side A of Tape 6 begins at this point.)

--I was aware of how big a name your band got to be, but looking back on these articles in Orchestra World and Downbeat, there's a picture of you and Count Basie and my dear friend Jimmy Rushing, your piano player, Lee Wesley Jones, I worked in Johnny Otis' band with him; Carl White--what is Carl playing?
Carl is on bass now, Oklahoma City.
